section_header: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — Rear Drive Shaft
title: DISASSEMBLY OF REAR DRIVE SHAFT

content.description: Diagram showing rear drive shaft assembly with outboard and inboard ends labeled, including boot clamps and joints

items: (a) Check to see that the outboard joint slides smoothly in the three direction. Check to see that there is no remarkable play in the radial direction of the outboard joint.
(b) Check to see that there is no remarkable play in the radial direction of the inboard joint.

content.description: Diagram showing hand removing boot clamp from drive shaft

content.text: 2. DISASSEMBLE FOUR BOOT CLAMPS OF OUTBOARD AND INBOARD JOINTS
NOTE: Slide the clamp toward the drive shaft and remove it.
3. SLIDE BOOTS AT CENTER OF SHAFT

content.description: Diagram showing removal of snap ring from outboard joint outer race
Diagram showing outer race and drive shaft with matchmarks indicated

items: (b) Place matchmarks on the outer race and drive shaft.

content.text: NOTE: Do not use a punch.

items: (c) Remove the outer race to the drive shaft.

content.text: NOTE: If the end cover is damaged or worn, replace it.

content.description: Diagram showing use of plastic hammer to tap on outer circumference of cage to remove balls from outboard joint inner race

items: (a) Using a plastic hammer, remove the balls by lightly tapping on the outer circumference of the cage in the shaft axial direction.
(b) Lower the cage to the inboard side.
